rationale: Solid technical depth with honest acknowledgment of streaming latency gaps and concrete past-win references (Initech, Globex with dollar amounts), but the output is visibly truncated so full section coverage is uncertain, and the risk dashboard — while functional with clause filtering — is slightly less polished than the swarm's SVG-gauge implementation.

Produces the most sophisticated risk dashboard (SVG arc gauge, severity badges, clause-level filtering, decision banner) and covers all major proposal sections with named buyer contacts and clear pricing/timeline, though specificity falls just short of dynamic's TCO-percentage-level detail.

Most comprehensive and decision-ready proposal — explicit requirements-mapping table, 5-year TCO comparisons with percentages against named competitors, two named reference wins, company credentialing, and the clearest go-live and migration deadline targets — but the risk-assessment HTML is the simplest of the three, lacking the SVG gauge and filtering sophistication of the other strategies.
